excerpt_i18n.en: On August 8, at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, the 10th lecture of "New Species Explosion · Wu Sheng's Business Methodology Release 2026" was held as scheduled. Wu Sheng, founder of Scene Lab, shared his observations on multiple tracks over the past year, with smart glasses being one of them. He named Rokid and offered a judgment: consumer-grade AI hardware must be both AI Native and AI Normal. Full functionality is the starting point for everyday use. Wu Sheng said openly at the opening that smart glasses are an AI hardware form he has long tracked. "They are naturally closest to you, close to your line of sight, with very direct interaction potential." In his view, many products on the market over the past few years have leaned either toward audio or toward photography, with relatively single functions, while Rokid chose a full-function route with display. "Only with full functionality can they truly support everyday use." He gave an example from his own experience: "Before going out, the glasses pushed today's schedule and reminded me how long until boarding.
